page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.6xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture utilizing an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 24 dedicated vCPUs derived from 12 physical cores with Hyper-Threading enabled. It is equipped with 48.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 2.0 GB per core ratio. No local storage or GPU hardware is bundled with this instance.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by bottom-25% scores in stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, alongside poor single-threaded gzip compression. However, the 24-vCPU configuration elevates multi-core performance to average levels, with middle-50% results in multi-core stress-ng, Geekbench, and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth is stable, with cached read-only speeds reaching 982.55 GB/sec and uncached large-block reads at 90.83 GB/sec.

The instance presents a qualitative tradeoff between single-threaded execution speed and parallel processing capacity. While single-threaded tasks are constrained by the older processor architecture, the dedicated CPU allocation and 4 Gbps baseline network bandwidth provide reliable throughput for multi-threaded workloads. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it a resource-dense option for compute-heavy tasks that do not require massive memory footprints. It is suitable for parallelized workloads such as multi-threaded decompression, software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations.
